description: Set (or clear) the default author for NEW blog articles. Without publicationId it sets the brand-wide default; with publicationId it sets that publication's default, which wins over the brand default. Resolution for a new article: explicit authorId > publication default > brand default > oldest active author. The author must be an active author of the brand (list_blog_authors). Pass authorId: null to clear. Existing articles are not changed (use update_blog_article with authorId).

authorId.description: Author ID (from list_blog_authors), or null to clear the default

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

publicationId.description: Publication ID (from list_publications). Omit to set the brand-wide default.

name: set_default_blog_author
